description: Bumps the deploy bundle's pinned images, each as a PR whose restore drill must pass before it merges (DESIGN 10.4; deploy/runbook.md, Upgrades). Dependabot keeps the actions current (.github/dependabot.yml), so Renovate reads only these two files. Litestream's version in Dockerfile.pairtimed is bumped by hand, since its two SHA-256 sums change with it.

packageRules.description: pairtimed's own releases, including prereleases such as v0.1.0-alpha.2.
